contract.seeds: own body plus ancestors; no seed subtree
contract.expand: all delivered bodies, including ancestors and definition owners
contract.anchor: unique owning section through next heading of same or lower level
contract.document: exact checked local Markdown path without fragment: full document
contract.definitions: whole owner body and its actual links
contract.unresolved: delivered dependency gap => body-free dependency_incomplete refusal; unselected graph gaps are diagnostics only; no fetch or scope expansion
contract.syntax: existing masked Markdown inline/full/collapsed/defined-shortcut/footnote and quoted HTML href/id/name; images are unsupported assets
contract.identity: full native scope/version/generation/content/catalog identity, not path alone
